questions.prompt: A contractor needs to download one private Azure blob for 20 minutes. The issuing application can authenticate through Microsoft Entra ID. Which approach follows Microsoft's recommended SAS signing method?

options.text: Issue a read-only user delegation SAS for that blob.
options.explanation: Entra-backed delegation avoids sharing or storing an account signing key.
It can delegate access, but does not use the recommended available Entra-backed signing method.

options.text: Send an account SAS permitting all storage services.
options.explanation: This expands both scope and signing-key exposure beyond the scenario.
An account key is not constrained to one blob or 20 minutes.

questions.prompt: Which two Azure CLI options select Entra-backed user delegation when generating a Blob SAS with az storage blob generate-sas?

options.explanation: This selects the signed-in Entra identity.
This selects user delegation SAS generation.
This supplies a Shared Key credential instead.
A stored access policy applies to a service SAS, not user delegation.

questions.prompt: A Blob user delegation SAS declares an expiry three days from now, but its signing delegation key expires tonight. Network access and permissions are correct. What happens after the key expires?

options.text: The SAS can no longer authorize requests.
options.explanation: A SAS cannot remain usable beyond its signing delegation key.

options.text: Storage automatically renews the key for the remaining three days.
options.explanation: The service does not renew the issuer's delegation key automatically.

options.text: The SAS switches to account key2.
options.explanation: The existing signature cannot change signing keys.

options.text: A container stored access policy extends the key.
options.explanation: Stored policies do not apply to user delegation SAS.

questions.prompt: An identity has Storage Blob Data Reader only on one container. It cannot obtain a user delegation key for the storage account. Which additional scoped grant addresses key generation while retaining narrow data access?

options.text: Storage Blob Delegator on the storage account.
options.explanation: The account-level delegation action can be combined with the existing container data role.

options.text: Storage Blob Data Reader on another container.
options.explanation: A container assignment does not grant the account-level key-generation action.

options.text: Enable anonymous read on the container.
options.explanation: Public reading does not authorize delegation-key generation.

options.text: Create a stored access policy on the container.
options.explanation: A stored policy controls service SAS, not this Entra operation.
